No network operations, dynamic downloads, or post-install scripts are present in this file. As `.SRCINFO` is generated from a PKGBUILD and not executed, it cannot introduce runtime behavior or malicious payloads by itself.

While the binary nature of the package means the actual code isn't auditable from this file alone, the metadata itself shows no signs of tampering or suspicious configuration.
